title: Cicero, Pro Archia
text: This web site is planned to include a readable text of Cicero’s Pro Archia with a variety of visualizations presenting syntactic analysis of the text.

title: Cicero, Pro Archia
text:
How it works
The arsgrammatica Python package analyzes the syntax of Latin texts. This project’s github repository includes analyses of Pro Archia that were automatically generated by an early version of arsgrammatica, and interactive Marimo notebooks to format and visualize the results. These notebooks can be exported to web apps (WASM format), and hosted on http://shot.holycross.edu.
